schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
schemes.purpose: Term-loan and working-capital credit for eligible micro enterprises.
conditions: Tarun Plus requires a successfully repaid earlier Tarun loan
schemes.interest: Lender-dependent. No guaranteed low interest rate.
schemes.limit: Shishu up to ₹50,000; Kishore up to ₹5 lakh; Tarun up to ₹10 lakh; Tarun Plus up to ₹20 lakh subject to prior repayment.

schemes.name: CGTMSE credit guarantee
schemes.purpose: Ask an eligible lender about guarantee-backed credit for a micro or small enterprise.
conditions: The lender applies for the guarantee
schemes.interest: Lender-dependent. This is not a direct loan or subsidy.
schemes.limit: Check the current guarantee scheme and lender terms.
